material.description: blocked_by: gap-wasip2-sim-surface-blocker-gm-oscraft-sc2-alt-1-p11. The wasip2 premise is stale (wasip2 removed in 9ad18d2; ModHost::load_source exists at rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs:986). The wasip3 guest (rust/crates/wasip3/src/lib.rs reply) refuses mod-load with 'built without the mod runtime' and has no mod-host dependency. Linking mod-host into wasm32-wasip3 hits the lua-src 547.0.0 build.rs fallthrough panic 'don't know how to build Lua for <target>' (only linux, bsd, apple, windows, emscripten arms). Needs an owner decision on the Lua dependency for wasm32-wasi (lua-src wasi arm, patched fork, or non-C Lua) before the wasip3 mod surface can be exposed and witnessed by the wasip3 CI job. Receipts: .gm/receipts/gap-wasip2-sim-surface-blocker-gm-oscraft-sc2-alt-1-p11/01-orient.md, 02-unknowns.md, 03-eliminate.md.
